machine_id.description: Unique identifier for this XRDP server instance.

log_file.description: Path to the main XRDP log file.

certificate.description: Path to X.509 certificate file (PEM format), required for 'x509' security layer.

key_file.description: Path to private key file (PEM format), required for 'x509' security layer.

ssl_protocols.description: Comma-separated list of allowed SSL/TLS protocols.

allow_tls13.description: Enable TLS 1.3 (if supported by underlying OpenSSL).

listen_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to localhost only.

max_bpp.description: Maximum bits per pixel supported (16, 24, or 32).

new_cursors.description: Allow custom cursor shapes (instead of default Windows cursors).

fips_mode.description: Enable FIPS-compliant cryptographic operations (requires OpenSSL FIPS module).

idle_max_time.description: Maximum idle time (seconds) before session is disconnected. 0 = no limit.

reuse_sessions.description: Reuse existing user sessions instead of creating new ones.

xserver_startup_delay.description: Delay (seconds) before starting X server after session request.

font_path.description: Path to directory containing TrueType fonts for XRDP.

bitmap_cache.description: Enable bitmap caching for improved performance.

persistent_bitmap.description: Persist bitmap cache across sessions (requires client support).

audio_redirection.description: Enable audio output redirection to client (requires PulseAudio/ALSA on server).

drive_redirection.description: Enable local drive (e.g., /home/user/Downloads) mapping into session.
